scripts.start: npm run check:runtime --silent && npm run start:development
scripts.start:development: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=development PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 expo start --dev-client --host lan --port 3000
scripts.start:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=testing PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 expo start --dev-client --host lan --port 3000
scripts.start:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=staging PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 expo start --dev-client --host lan --port 3000
scripts.start:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=production PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 expo start --dev-client --host lan --port 3000
scripts.start:dev: npm run check:runtime --silent && npm run start:development
scripts.start:dev:tunnel: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=development expo start --dev-client --tunnel
scripts.android: npm run check:runtime --silent && npm run start:development -- --android
scripts.ios: npm run check:runtime --silent && npm run start:development -- --ios
scripts.web: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=development expo start --web --port 3000
scripts.run:android:development: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=development PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:android --port 3000
scripts.run:ios:development: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=development PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:ios --port 3000
scripts.run:android:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=testing PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:android --port 3000
scripts.run:ios:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=testing PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:ios --port 3000
scripts.run:android:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=staging PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:android --port 3000
scripts.run:ios:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=staging PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:ios --port 3000
scripts.run:android:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=production PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:android --port 3000 --variant release
scripts.run:ios:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=production PORT=3000 REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_PORT=3000 npx expo run:ios --port 3000 --configuration Release
scripts.build:dev:android: npm run check:runtime --silent && npm run run:android:development
scripts.build:dev:ios: npm run check:runtime --silent && npm run run:ios:development
scripts.build:android:development: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p android --profile development
scripts.build:ios:development: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p ios --profile development
scripts.build:android:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p android --profile testing
scripts.build:ios:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p ios --profile testing
scripts.build:android:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p android --profile staging
scripts.build:ios:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p ios --profile staging
scripts.build:android:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.build:ios:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas build -p ios --profile production
scripts.update:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas update --channel testing
scripts.update:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas update --channel staging
scripts.update:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && eas update --channel production
scripts.prebuild:development: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=development npx expo prebuild --clean
scripts.prebuild:testing: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=testing npx expo prebuild --clean
scripts.prebuild:staging: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=staging npx expo prebuild --clean
scripts.prebuild:production: npm run check:runtime --silent && cross-env APP_ENV=production npx expo prebuild --clean
